intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
Test a biohybrid robot as an independent non-humanoid machine integrating visibly living contractile tissue with engineered synthetic structure.

Create a high-detail environmental photograph in a moonlit tidal greenhouse laboratory. An unmistakably adult soft-robotics engineer derived from the supplied portrait’s oval face, brown eyes, and long dark wavy hair kneels beside a saltwater channel and guides a manta-shaped biohybrid robot with a narrow light wand. The robot is an independent non-humanoid organism-machine: translucent polymer ribs, embedded microelectrodes, and flexible engineered fins surround clearly visible pink living muscle bands. A sequence of contracted and relaxed tissue regions visibly bends the synthetic scaffold as it swims between mangrove roots. Fine cables end at the robot rather than entering the engineer’s body. Condensation, rippling caustics, cultured tissue trays, and instrument bridges create a dense believable workspace. Frame the engineer in three-quarter profile with the complete robot and its organic-synthetic interface readable, using silver moonlight, soft amber grow lamps, realistic wet materials, and crisp documentary detail.
